description_en: Modifies the billing method. Currently, this operation only allows you to change the billing method from pay-as-you-go to subscription
description_zh: 修改实例的付费方式。目前只支持按量付费转为包年包月
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic modify-instance-charge-type --instance-group-ids ag-25nt4kk9whhdh0000 --charge-type PrePaid --period 1 --period-unit Month --auto-pay false --auto-renew false --promotion-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceChargeType

parameters.help_en:
The new billing method for the instance groups.

> You can only change the billing method from pay-as-you-go to subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费类型。
> 目前只支持**按量付费转为包年包月**
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. The PeriodUnit parameter specifies the unit. Valid subscription durations are 1, 2, 3, and 6 months, and 1 year
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长，单位由PeriodUnit指定。
取值范围：1个月、2个月、3个月、6个月、1年
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit for the subscription duration. Valid values:

- **Month**

- **Year**
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。
取值范围：
- **Month**：月。
- **Year**：年
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-payment. The default value is `false`
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. The default value is `false`
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动续费。默认为false
parameters.name: auto_renew
